column4: Add a provider-free cryptohaunt preflight command that validates the registered H2 retry predicates without changing authorization or calling a provider: manifest safety boundary is closed, registered model/tape/design paths exist and hash, and the check records an explicit exclusive-provider requirement without pretending to prove it offline. Add focused tests and a receipt with command/exit evidence and pane:haunt observation. Acceptance: the new command fails closed on a closed/invalid manifest, passes its offline fixture, and the full selftest remains green; no live model call or authorization mutation.
